note_equityShare: Share of investable capital in equity (direct, active, index, sector, international), by horizon in years. Linear between anchors, flat beyond the ends, so the targets move continuously with the horizon.

equitySplit.note: How the equity share divides. Direct equity is the swing allocation (the Swing Desk reads it as its capital line); sector and thematic default to zero with a cap.

hybridFold.note: Hybrid has no target of its own. A hybrid holding counts as equity and debt (and gold) by its category's mandated midpoint, until fund-level mix is available (phase 8).

bearMarketEquityFallNote: Drawdown limit before the portfolio is reviewed = equity share x this fall, so it moves with the horizon.

rebalance.note: A sale is skipped below the minimum trade (rupees) or when tax plus charges plus any exit load exceed this share of the sale, unless it is an Exit-verdict name. A class acted on this calendar quarter gets no new sale suggestion unless its drift passes quarterCap.overrideBandMultiple x its band. fundVerdictSales stays false until the fund-score back-test has run (design section 9.1): when true, a fund flagged Replace candidate is treated as an already-decided sale.

swingPools.note: Each account's capital is recorded as own income, so the cash step of routing is skipped.

swingMatch.status: APPROVED as working values by the owner on 20 Oct 2026; not yet tested on shortlist history (2 nights). Review after 40 or more shortlist nights. A wrong near match is only a proposal the owner can reject.
swingMatch.note: A buy is Swing automatically when it is on the entry session inside the shortlist trigger and limit. A buy up to nearSessions weekdays after a shortlist night, or up to nearPricePct percent (of the trigger) outside its trigger-to-limit range, is proposed and needs the owner's yes. volatileExtraPct widens the top of the range for a stock with ATR above 3% of price, whose entry is an after-market limit at a confirming close + 1% (Engine Rules, entry order type). A line the desk tagged 'over cap' or 'room fail' can only be a near match. maxExactPctOfAccount: an exact match whose cost is above this share of the account's value is only a near match (a position that large is not the sized trade). addWindowSessions: a later buy of a stock that already matched a shortlist line, within this many sessions of that buy, is proposed as an add to that trade (also covers a second order the same day). The add window is 12 sessions because the desk's own rules only add at the first close at +1R, and the time stop (Engine Rules exits, rule 4) sells a trade that has no +1R close within 10 sessions, so a rule-based add can only come within about 11 sessions of entry (the add order is placed the next morning). Approved by the owner 20 Oct 2026: all five values (nearSessions 3, nearPricePct 2, volatileExtraPct 5, maxExactPctOfAccount 6, addWindowSessions 12) as working values, to be reviewed once 40 or more shortlist nights and real buys exist.
